name: Ahmad bin Hassan
bio:
Ahmad's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. After years managing supply chains for a Kuala Lumpur-based electronics firm, a chance encounter with a local racing team led him to realize his organizational skills could be applied to the high-octane world of racing. He started as a volunteer, quickly impressing the team with his meticulous planning and problem-solving abilities.

His approach to logistics is simple: anticipate every possible hurdle and have a solution ready. He's known for his relentless pursuit of efficiency, ensuring that every part and piece of equipment arrives at the track on time and in perfect condition. While some may find his demands exacting, Ahmad's dedication to the team's success is undeniable. His lone wolf nature means he prefers to work independently, making decisions quickly and decisively.

What sets Ahmad apart is his ability to remain calm under pressure. Even when faced with last-minute changes or unexpected delays, he maintains a steady demeanor, finding creative solutions to keep the team on track. His experience and unflappable attitude make him an invaluable asset to Praga Racing.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Ahmad is a man of average height with a sturdy build and a perpetually serious expression.

quirks: Insists on using only analog stopwatches for timing practice runs.
Always carries a small notebook filled with meticulously detailed checklists.
Has a peculiar habit of aligning objects perfectly on his desk.
